correctness.rationale: For scalar OU with lambda,sigma>0, iid two-valued positive steps a<b, P(H=a)=rho in (0,1), stationary update-index state is a centered Gaussian with bounded random variance V obeying V=q_H Vprime+(1-q_H)v_H. Its upper endpoint v_a=sigma^2/[lambda(2+lambda a)] and deficit D=v_a-V satisfy D=alpha Dprime for short steps, D=beta Dprime+B for long steps; geometric initial short-run length yields P(D<=eps) between constants eps^kappa, kappa=log(1/rho)/log(1/alpha). Uniform Gaussian Mills bounds transfer this to P(X>t) asymptotic-equivalence up to constants t^(-1-2kappa)exp[-t^2/(2v_a)], not an asserted convergent prefactor. Exact independent rational calculations confirmed both step laws have EH=2, stationary variance 7/27 but Gaussian rates 3/2 and 7/4, producing log tail ratio/t^2 ->1/4. The infinite tail result follows analytically, not from finite tests.
